answer: Give every identity a kernel of sequential work: a verifiable delay function that takes genuine wall-clock time and cannot be parallelised. Like light through a prism, one operator's effort splits into only one valid proof per time window, no matter how many names it invents. A sybil farm trying to mint thousands of identities would face a dune of waiting time, each grain a delay it cannot shortcut, so fake accounts stay rare, costly, and easy to spot against real agents with steady histories.
